description_en: Upgrades the gateway class of an online gateway
description_zh: 可对线上网关的网关规格进行升配
kebab_example: aliyun sgw modify-gateway-class --gateway-id gw-0001xv7580031yzun000 --gateway-class Enhanced --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyGatewayClass

parameters.help_en:
The gateway class to which you want to upgrade. You can call the DescribeGatewayModificationClasses operation to query the available gateway classes. Valid values:

Basic

Standard

Enhanced

Advanced
parameters.help_zh:
升配的网关规格。可升配的规格可以通过DescribeGatewayModificationClasses接口查询。可能值：

Basic：基础型。

Standard：标准型。

Enhanced：增强型。

Advanced：性能型
parameters.name: gateway_class
